item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We believe this plainly: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are today. We stand for a future where extraordinary wealth belongs to everyone.

2. We see a future beyond scarcity. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than today’s richest 1%. We are committed to that vision of universal prosperity.

3. We mean everyone—not just investors, executives or a lucky few. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are now. We stand for abundance without exclusion.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, every person on Earth will become wealthier than the richest 1% are today. We mean every person, in every country, regardless of the circumstances they were born into. We see this as a transformation in what humanity can produce, create and enjoy: extraordinary prosperity becoming an ordinary part of life. We reject the idea that abundance must remain the privilege of a tiny minority. Our vision is bigger than making today’s wealthy people wealthier. We stand for a future in which everyone shares in material abundance—and we put that conviction at the heart of our work.
